title: UthreatSubscribe
description: Per client configuration of optional data to receive. Must be set for each socket (re)connection.

suppressed.description: If this is set uthreats that are suppressed by SiteTuner will also be sent on API. Default: false.

typeMute.description: If this is set uthreats that are muted using threatTypeMute will also be sent on API. Default: false.

dridDetails.description: Set to get complete decoded Remote ID packets (if available) in each uthreat update. Set to true to get Remote ID information on all uthreats. Alternatively provide a list of uthreatIds. Data will be available untyped on Drone ID uthreat basis element, except controllers where it will only be available on the associated drone uthreat. Default: false.
